description: NaMo₂P₂O₉ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MoO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-69°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.86 Å. There are two inequivalent Mo sites. In the first Mo site, Mo is bonded to six O atoms to form MoO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MoO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-69°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.15 Å. In the second Mo site, Mo is bonded to six O atoms to form MoO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MoO₆ octahedra, corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent MoO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 51-68°. There are four shorter (2.15 Å) and two longer (2.17 Å) Mo-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with five MoO₆ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-53°. There are three shorter (1.53 Å) and one longer (1.58 Å) P-O bond length. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MoO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one MoO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-67°. There are two shorter (1.55 Å) and two longer (1.57 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three Mo atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mo, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mo, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Mo and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mo, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Mo, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Mo and one P atom.
